steps.en: Add the planner BOM and annotate the domain classes you want planned
steps.zh: 加上 planner BOM，并给要规划的领域类打注解

steps.en: Declare the business rules as constraints over those classes
steps.zh: 把业务规则写成基于这些类的约束

steps.en: Build a solver from config and hand it the problem
steps.zh: 按配置建出求解器，把问题交给它

steps.en: Construction heuristics build a first feasible plan
steps.zh: 构造启发式先给出一份可行的初始方案

steps.en: Local search swaps and moves entities, re-scoring each move incrementally instead of from scratch
steps.zh: 局部搜索不断换位置、移动对象，每一步增量算分而不是重算

steps.en: Returns the best plan found before the termination limit, with its HardSoftScore
steps.zh: 在终止时限前返回找到的最好方案，以及它的 HardSoftScore

value.en: The historical OptaPlanner workflow — annotations plus a score-based rules DSL — which is why existing 9.x projects and OptaPy scripts still read this way
value.zh: 注解加算分规则 DSL 这套 OptaPlanner 工作流——现存 9.x 项目与 OptaPy 脚本仍是这个样子
